name: Dutch Oven Bread Loaf
directions: Stir yeast and water and let yeast sit until bloomed
In a large bowl mix flour and salt. Once incorporated form a small well and pour in yeast mixture
Mix the dough by hand until it doesn't stick to your fingers. If sticky, add 1 TBSP of flour at a time
Once formed, cover the bowl and let dough sit for about 1.5 to 2 hours until doubled in size
Uncover dough and using hands starting from the rim, fold dough to the center of the bowl turning 90 degrees each time.
Cover bowl and let dough rest for another 1.5 to 2 hours
Once dough has doubled in size, transfer out of bowl onto a floured surface
Shape the dough by folding the dough under itself and pinch seams at the bottom
Transfer dough into a clean bowl that is covered in the olive oil and a small dusting of flour
Let rise for 1 hour, meanwhile place a 6 quart dutch oven into an oven and preheat to 450° F with the pot inside for about 45-60 minutes
Take pot out of the oven and place the proofed dough into the dutch oven. VERY HOT
Bake with lid on for 45 min and then 15 without
Remove bread from pot and cool for 10 min before slicing.
